2609.15015.title: Four Ledgers, Not One Score: Responsible Communication of LLM-Judge Calibration in Biomedical ML
2609.15015.paper_summary: Synthetic perturbations appear to offer inexpensive calibration data for LLM evaluators in biomedical ML, where expert review is scarce. Yet a planted mutation key is neither a detector output nor automatically human ground truth. We formalize four distinct ledgers: planted perturbations, independent detector outputs, source-linked human dispositions, and human-added discoveries. We then audit the evaluation design, scoring code, read paths, and current human records of a private synthetic Japanese care-handoff workflow. The factory stored 69 planted error cards across 47 targets. Final review covers 22 targets and contains 22 confirmed imported proposals, 9 rejected proposals, and 79 human-added cards; only 3 reviewed targets are double annotated. Passing imported plant keys to a generic detector scorer yields 22/(22+9)=0.710 and 22/(22+79)=0.218. A direct audit identity shows that these values are proposal-confirmation yield and submitted-ledger composition, not judge precision and recall, because no independent detector realization was preserved for the audited proposals in the available records. The audit also finds source-name collisions, row shadowing, forced severity, vacuous ratio defaults, and unsupported zero-support field weights. We contribute a provenance-aware claim audit, a storage contract, and a minimum calibration gate for responsibly communicating biomedical ML capability claims. This single-workflow forensic case is an existence proof of a failure mode, not an estimate of its prevalence: existing human work supports an exploratory audit of synthetic proposals, but not LLM-judge operating characteristics, clinical validity, corpus prevalence, or robust inter-annotator agreement.
2609.15015.paper_summary_zh: 合成擾動似乎為生物醫學機器學習中的大型語言模型評估者提供了廉價的校準數據，因為專家審查稀缺。然後，植入的突變鍵既不是檢測器輸出，也不是自動的人類真實數據。我們正式化了四種不同的帳本：植入擾動、獨立檢測器輸出、源鏈接的人類處置和人類添加的發現。然後，我們審核評估設計、計分代碼、閱讀路徑和一個私有合成日本護理交接工作流程的當前人類記錄。該工廠在47個目標中存儲了69個植入錯誤卡。最終審查涵蓋22個目標，並包含22個確認的導入提案、9個被拒絕的提案和79個人類添加的卡片；只有3個被審查的目標是雙重標註的。將導入的植入鍵傳遞給通用檢測器計分器，得出22/(22+9)=0.710和22/(22+79)=0.218。直接審計身份顯示這些值是提案確認產量和提交帳本組成，而不是評審精度和召回率，因為在可用記錄中沒有為審計的提案保留獨立檢測器的實現。審計還發現了源名稱碰撞、行陰影、強制嚴重性、空洞的比例默認值和不支持的零支持字段權重。我們提供了一個考慮來源的聲明審計、一個存儲合同和一個最低校準門檻，以負責任地傳達生物醫學機器學習能力聲明。這個單一工作流程的法醫案例是一種失效模式的存在證明，而不是其普遍性的估計：現有的人類工作支持對合成提案的探索性審計，但不支持大型語言模型評審的操作特徵、臨床有效性、語料庫的普遍性或穩健的標註者之間一致性。
2609.15015.author: Sidi Chang et.al.
